title: feat(core): import reads dotted and compact year-first days and matches option values in any case
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDWJsBGQpadCH8JR2xZQ5re)_

Part of #25582

Clause-②: yes (widening: two date-cell spellings and an option value in another case, each refused before with `invalid_date` / `invalid_option`, are now read; nothing read before is refused or stored differently)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Ruling 6377844879 (on #25493, letter A), proposals **1** and **2**, in `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts`:

1. **`parseDateCell` reads `YYYY.MM.DD` and `YYYYMMDD`.** A four-digit year, a two-digit month and day, nothing else in the cell. `2011.07.01` is stored as `2011-07-01`, `20090615` as `2009-06-15`. The day must exist (`namesRealCalendarDay`, the same arithmetic as the other shapes): `20090230` and `2009.02.30` stay `invalid_date`. No other form is widened: `2011.7.1`, `2011.07.01 9:00`, `11.07.01`, `01.07.2011`, `2011.07-01`, `200961`, `2009615`, `200906150` and `20090615 9:00` stay refused.
   - **Field kinds.** Read for a `date` and a `datetime` (midnight UTC, the reading a bare `2026/7/15` already gets on a `datetime`), never for a `time`: both spellings name a day and no clock. The `time` branch keeps its year-first-only fallback unchanged.
   - **A number is not a compact day.** The compact form is read only from a text cell, so a JSON number `20090615` stays refused. The existing reader treats numbers as never temporal (`outsideYears` docblock: an Excel serial, epoch ms). An xlsx cell holding that number reaches the reader as its text (`xlsxCellToString` in `import-prepare.ts`), so it is read. That path is read from the code, not measured.
   - An eight-digit cell on a `number` or `text` column is unaffected (`20090615` → the number `20090615` / the text `'20090615'`). This is pinned.
2. **Option values match case-insensitively.** `matchOption` now has three passes: exact value, then label case-insensitively (as before), then value case-insensitively. It stores the declared value, never the cell's spelling: `CN` stores `cn`. The value pass runs last, so a cell that matched before stores what it stored (pinned: a cell that is one option's label and, by case, another option's value keeps the label match). Single select, `multiple: true` select and multiselect parts all go through this one function.
   - **Ambiguity, measured.** The spec cannot declare two values that differ only by case: `FieldSchema.safeParse` on `[{value:'cn'},{value:'CN'}]` fails at `options.1.value` ("System identifier must be lowercase…"). A programmatic `engine.registry.registerObject` accepts and keeps the pair unparsed. Measured with a throwaway test against `@objectstack/objectql`, then deleted. So the pass refuses to guess. A cell naming two such values by case alone (`Cn`) gets the no-match answer it got before (`invalid_option`, or kept under `createMissingOptions`). An exact `cn` / `CN` still matches exactly. The same value declared twice counts as one value.

#25582 remains open: proposal 4 (every cell error of a row) is not in this PR. It needs an `errors` member on `ImportRowResultSchema` first (the `domain:spec` seat's; the note is on the card), and `import-runner.ts` still keeps `errors[0]`. Proposal 3 (`aliases`) was not ruled in.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.test.ts`: a `[#25582]` block covering the new forms on `date` and `datetime`, the invalid-calendar controls, the not-widened controls, `time` refusal, number refusal, the 8-digit number/text control, and the row-level `invalid_date`. `matchOption` gets value-case match storing the canonical value, label-ahead-of-value, and the ambiguous pair. `coerceRow` gets select, multiselect and `multiple: true` select parts stored canonical, with `keptOptionValues` empty and an unmatched part named.
- `packages/rest/src/import-year-first-day-option-case.test.ts` (new): through the real `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), a CSV row `2011.07.01,20090615,CN` imports and stores `2011-07-01` / `2009-06-15` / `cn`. The JSON dry run of the same row is clean and persists nothing. `20090230` and `DE` are still that row's `invalid_date` / `invalid_option`.

**Ablation, once per proposal.** Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob moved). Then `@objectstack/core` was rebuilt, because the rest test reads core's `dist/`, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` saw the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`.
- **P1** (the `readYearFirstDay` call removed): core 9 failed / 167 passed of 176. Route 3 failed of 3 (`ok: 0, errors: 1` on the ledger row).
- **P2** (the value pass returns nothing): core 3 failed / 173 passed. Route 2 failed / 1 passed (the refusal case stays green, as expected).
- **Restore.** Blob == HEAD (`60af90a93041`), `git diff HEAD` empty. Core rebuilt, and `--absent` passed for both markers on all 14 built files with a clean tree.

## Gates

All readings below were taken at head `c630eacca0` (after merging `origin/main`), unless a line names another commit.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 70 commands. All 70 ran and exited 0. `--ran` gives: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `pnpm lint`, through the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`: 118 files / 2757 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` passed (each package's test-layer `check:test-typecheck: OK`). Both through the lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run` over the new file plus `import-date-cell-iso-real-day`, `import-dryrun-parity` and `import-integration`: 4 files / 119 tests passed.
- After the merge: the `@objectstack/rest` closure was rebuilt, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` gives `✓ All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the whole `@objectstack/rest` suite (only a test file is added there; CI `Test Core` runs it) and `test:repo` (no repo-project test is touched).

## Acceptance notes

- The xlsx template's instructions sheet (`TEMPLATE_READER_CLAIMS` in `packages/rest/src/import-template.ts`) lists example date spellings and does not mention the two new ones. Every claim it makes is still true (none of its refused examples is now read). Adding them is outside this slice's file surface. carrier: none.
- `2011.7.1` (dotted, one-digit month/day) stays refused, per the ruling's 「不放宽其它形式」. Widening it would be a new decision.
